main_body: A drawer chest (dresser) with a lit top surface carrying small props (a bottle, a yellow-blue item, a red box) and a front face with four recessed drawers
top_band: Rows 7-11 (5 rows), orange-brown L=130, with props standing on it; row 12 is a lighter front-edge line (L=157)
evidence: Column x=8 reads as a 5-row top (rows 7-11), then a distinct light edge line at row 12 (L157). Row 13 is mid tone and row 14 is a dark eave shadow (L60). Below that is the front face (rows 15-30) with drawers inset behind dark frame lines and dark inner edges. This matches the green cabinet in the guide (top 5 + edge + eave). The top is close in tone to the face (L130 vs L109), but the edge line and eave row separate them. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The measured dark edge pixels are 100% near-neutral, against 1% and 33% for the references. The outer edge is a pure black line (#000000 on the bottom row and the sides), which gives the sticker look rather than a dark tone of the adjacent wood. The candidate has 20 distinct colours against 38-40 for the references, and 14 colours per tile against 17-20. The wood ramp is only about 4 steps (dark brown, mid, light, highlight). Flat-fill coverage is low at 3%, and drawer handles and dark frame lines add some detail. It is still thinner than the references and has a black outline, so it fails.
